evidence: Changes minimum language standard to C++23 across CMakeLists.txt, depends, and CI build configurations, setting minimum compilers to GCC 13 or Clang 19.
rationale: Raising the minimum language standard to C++23 across CMake, depends, and CI transitions the project to modern compiler toolchains and unblocks broader modernization tracked in #34979. As the author notes, 'the workarounds to avoid C++23 keep accumulating' and downstream dependencies have already moved forward.
